kubectl exec -- sh fails on distroless containers because there is no shell binary — use kubectl debug with --image=busybox:1.36 to inject a debug toolbox alongside the running container

kubectl debug -it -n dojo-docker-distroless $(kubectl get pod -n dojo-docker-distroless -l app=api -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}') --image=busybox:1.36 --target=api — then run 'env | grep DATABASE' inside

Fix the ConfigMap: kubectl patch configmap app-config -n dojo-docker-distroless -p '{"data":{"DATABASE_URL":"postgresql://correct-host:5432/db"}}' then kubectl rollout restart deployment api -n dojo-docker-distroless
